title: Wolf Tooth Announces Road, Gravel, and Mountain Bike Hubs
content:
Wolf Tooth’s new hubs are engineered and machined in-house from aerospace-grade 7075-T6 aluminum and run on the Enve Innerdrive system. Each hub model features optimized weight, high rolling efficiency, prolonged bearing life, and immediate, zero flex engagement tailored to suit its intended riding applications.

Wolf Tooth Hubs Quick Hits

  • Straight Pull Road / Gravel – 24h
    • 326g F/R Set
  • Straight Pull XC/Trail MTB Boost – 28h
    • 371g F/R Set
  • J-Bend MTB Boost – 28h / 32h
    • 442g F/R Set
  • Enve Innerdrive ratchet system
    • 40T PRO, 60T, 80T, or 100T rings available
  • Available in six anodized colors: Black, Red, Blue, Gold, Orange, and Ultraviolet Purple
  • Pricing
    • Front – $239.95 USD
    • Rear – $489.95 USD
    • Set – $729.90 USD

Wolf Tooth’s angular form hub shells bring their design language to wheel building for the first time, and are available in three modern shapes destined to become instant classics. The Straight Pull Road / Gravel and XC / Trail hubs feature aggressive machining and smart material use for weight reduction without sacrificing durability. Our J-Bend hubs, built for anything from aggressive trail to DH riding, have their own unique, oversized aesthetic that aligns with the bombproof nature of their design. J-Bend front hubs accommodate a standard 15mm boost or 20mm front axle.

All Wolf Tooth Hubs are available in six Color Shop anodized finishes to match your other Wolf Tooth components and accessories. More hub colors will be available at a later date.

Hub Development

Our overarching goal when we began the hub development process was balance. We began by establishing what attributes make a great hub:

  • Rolling Efficiency
  • Bearing and Hub Shell Durability
  • Optimized Weight
  • Ease of Service

Options and Compatibility

Wolf Tooth’s next step was ride testing in all five Minnesota seasons: Spring, Summer, Fall, Winter, and Salt Season (IYKYK). They benchmarked the performance of what was available in the market, including specialty hubs designed for more niche applications. They saw tradeoffs in designs that had an imbalance in our benchmark criteria. If a hub is too light you begin to impact axle, drive system, and hub shell durability, certain drive systems can reduce bearing life, how easy is a hub to live with and service…with this data, they were able to see a clear path forward.

Once Wolf Tooth had established a clear benchmark, they set to engineering. They iterated and explored our own proprietary drive system in design and prototyping, coming to the conclusion that the Enve Innerdrive System not only hit their benchmark targets, but that it excelled in each category and gave the balance they were looking for. At this point, they utilized their network of ride testers and athletes around the world to pressure test and fine tune the design.

The result is a balanced hub that is optimized for pure performance and extreme durability, with a beautifully machined hub shell that is easy to service and configure to suit a wide range of rider preferences. The Innerdrive internals provide high rolling efficiency, prolonged bearing life, and immediate, zero flex engagement. The hubs are precision engineered and machined at Wolf Tooth HQ to be at the heart of road, gravel, and MTB riders’ next high performance wheel build.

Three Hubs / Optimized Performance

The Perfect Preload system eliminates the need for bearing preload adjustments using a tuned wave washer. Bearing preload is optimized and set during hub assembly (and during repeat tear down and re-assembly during service) and dynamically adjusts over the life of the hub. Simply torque the hub to spec. No special tools required.

The oversized Innerdrive ratchet rings found inside Wolf Tooth Hubs provide numerous benefits over traditional ratchet style hubs. First, the larger 42mm diameter drive rings allow for higher engagement tooth counts without sacrificing durability. Next, riders have the option of choosing between a 40T PRO*, 60T, 80T, or 100T drive ratchet to tune hub engagement and prioritize lower drag or quicker engagement. With the highest tooth count, our hubs will engage in as little as 3.6 degrees. Finally, this is paired with the Perfect Preload system which delivers tool-free, adjustment-free preload on the hub internals for prolonged bearing life, minimal maintenance, and reduced drag.

*40T PRO Ratchet: To save weight, the standard ratchet’s diameter is reduced, and additional material is milled out for weight savings. When paired with the INNERDRIVE ratchet spring, which applies a minimal amount of force to the drive rings, this delivers reliable hub engagement with minimal ratchet drag. The 40T PRO ratchet is our preferred setup, and ships stock in all Wolf Tooth Road / Gravel Hubs.

Wolf Tooth Hubs will require no special tools for maintenance, and their refined hub geometry incorporates many features that make living with and servicing the hubs easy. The straight pull hubs use anti-twist, no-touch spoke drillings that are engineered specifically for straight pull spokes. All hubs feature consistent spoke lengths per wheelset. Hubs use standardized bearing sizes across front and rear hubs. Riders can quickly and easily swap ratchets for customized engagement, and a circlip holds the oversized steel ratchets in place ensuring your freehub and ratchets won’t fall out during trailside or shop maintenance. There is no manually set preload, simply torque the end cap to spec and perfect preload is set, every time.

Wheel Builds

Wolf Tooth partnered with two of the finest carbon manufacturers laying up rims in North America to offer wheels that deliver the perfect balance of speed, durability, agility, and lightweight. Built in-house around Wolf Tooth Hubs with Innerdrive inside, they’re the perfect high-performance upgrade to any bike in your stable.

At launch, the following wheelsets are available:

  • Enve SES 4.5 – $2950
  • Enve G SES 4.5 – $2950
  • We Are One Whisp – $1975
  • We Are One Triad 29″ and Mullet – $1975
  • Enve M6 – $2400
  • Enve M8 – $2400

Alongside the big hub announcement, Wolf Tooth is launching a spoke calculator app built into its website. This gives riders and wheelbuilders a quick resource to calculate the spoke lengths they need when building a new wheelset with our hubs. It can also be used to calculate spoke lengths for other hub and rim combinations you have in your workshop.

Wolf Tooth Hubs are available now on wolftoothcomponents.com and via our network of dealers and distributors worldwide.
